description: Use this to see the durable event consumers on this account. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. No inputs. Returns {object:"list", data:[{object:"event_consumer", id, client_id, inbox_id, types, cursor, created_at, updated_at, last_polled_at, last_committed_at}]}. An inbox-scoped key sees only consumers pinned to its inbox. Another account's consumers are not listed.
name: cooper_list_event_consumers
title: List durable event consumers
